.panel { background: var(--panel); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); overflow-y: auto; padding: 14px 14px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--panel-3) transparent; }
.panel h3 { margin: 18px 0 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); }
.row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px 1fr 38px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 28px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.row output { text-align: right; color: var(--ink-3); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 11px; }

.tile { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--panel-2); padding: 9px 6px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); min-height: 40px; text-align: center; line-height: 1.2; }
.tile img { width: 56px; height: 56px; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 6px; }
.tile.on { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); background: var(--accent-soft); }

.tool { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--panel-2); height: 52px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 10.5px; }
.tool.on { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.chips button { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel-2); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 9px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.chips button.on { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); }
.check { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; color: var(--ink-2); margin: 6px 0; cursor: pointer; }
.panel .bar { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 6px; }

.toggle { width: 32px; height: 30px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; flex: none; }
.toggle.on { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); }
.stage { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%, var(--stage-top), var(--stage-bottom) 75%); }
.top { position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; top: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; pointer-events: none; }
.title { white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.title .gem { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--accent); transform: rotate(45deg); }

.tip { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; background: rgba(13, 15, 18, .92); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 6px; display: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.side { background: var(--panel); border-left: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 14px; gap: 8px; }
.side h2 { margin: 0 0 2px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); }
.gallery { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px; align-content: start; margin-top: 4px; }

.card { position: relative; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; padding: 3px; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.card img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; background: #2a2f37; display: block; margin-bottom: 3px; }

.card .x { position: absolute; top: 5px; right: 5px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 4px; border: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; opacity: 0; }
.inspector { position: absolute; right: 18px; top: 372px; width: 244px; padding: 12px; transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s; }
.rp-icon svg, .rp-tool svg, .rp-btn svg, .rp-issue svg, .rp-ok svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

.rp-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--v-line); background: var(--v-raise); font-weight: 650; }
.v2-pill.rp-open { width: auto; max-width: 170px; padding: 0 10px 0 8px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; }
.v2-pill.rp-open > span { position: static; width: auto; height: auto; overflow: hidden; clip: auto; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.rp-keys button { font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.rp-keys-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
.rp-keys .rp-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--v-muted); }
.rp-keys .rp-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }
.rp-keys-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; }

.rp-key { min-width: 86px; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--v-line); border-bottom-width: 3px; background: var(--v-raise, rgba(255,255,255,.05)); font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.rp-keys .rp-btn { justify-self: start; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--v-line); background: var(--v-raise); font-weight: 600; }
.v2-seg-b.rp-seg-text > span { position: static; width: auto; height: auto; overflow: visible; clip: auto; }
.rc-catalog { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; font: 12px/1.25 Inter, ui-sans-serif, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--v-text, #eef4f2); }
.rc-catalog button { font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.rc-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.22); justify-self: start; }

.rc-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 26px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 7px; border: 0; background: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; color: var(--v-muted, #a3b4b0); }
.rc-cards { display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto; padding: 2px 2px 6px; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: rgba(255,255,255,.18) transparent; }
.rc-card-main { display: grid; gap: 3px; width: 124px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; text-align: left; }
.v2 { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 5; color: var(--v-text); font: 13px/1.3 Inter, ui-sans-serif, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; }
.v2 button, .v2 select, .v2 input { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
.v2-city { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; }
.v2-stats { color: var(--v-muted); font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.v2-seg, .v2-speed { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--v-raise); border: 1px solid var(--v-line); }

.v2-warn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 28px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 111, 97, 0.55); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 111, 97, 0.14); color: var(--v-danger-ink); font-size: 12.5px; }
.v2-warn > span { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }
.v2-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.v2-icon.on, .v2-pill.on { color: var(--v-accent); border-color: var(--v-accent); background: var(--v-accent-soft); }
.v2-inside { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding-right: 4px; border-right: 1px solid var(--v-line); }
.v2-inside-level { min-width: 22px; padding: 0 2px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; }
.v2-pop { position: absolute; z-index: 9; min-width: 280px; max-width: min(380px, calc(100vw - 24px)); max-height: calc(100dvh - 100px); overflow: auto; padding: 6px; border-radius: var(--v-r); }
.v2-pop hr { width: 100%; height: 1px; margin: 4px 0; border: 0; background: var(--v-line); }

.v2-row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 38px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--v-r-s); background: none; text-align: left; font-size: 14px; }
.v2-row svg { flex: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; color: var(--v-muted); }
.v2-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 10px; top: 50%; width: 30px; height: 16px; margin-top: -8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); }

.v2-switch::before { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 26px; top: 50%; z-index: 1; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-top: -6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--v-muted); transition: transform 0.15s; }
.v2-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 4px 12px; margin: 4px 0 0; padding: 8px 10px 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--v-line); font-size: 13px; }
.v2-metrics dd { margin: 0; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.v2-pop-body.icons .v2-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; }
.v2-keys dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 4px 10px; margin: 4px 0 0; padding: 0 8px; align-items: baseline; }

.v2-keys kbd { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--v-line); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--v-raise); font-family: inherit; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; white-space: nowrap; }
.v2-more summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--v-accent); font-size: 12.5px; padding: 4px 0; }
.v2-help p { margin: 2px 0 0; color: var(--v-muted); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.45; }
.v2-cat.on { background: var(--v-accent-soft); border-color: var(--v-accent); color: var(--v-accent); }
.v2-cat.danger.on { background: rgba(255, 111, 97, 0.14); border-color: var(--v-danger); color: var(--v-danger); }
.v2-drawer-head { grid-area: head; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--v-line); }
.v2-drawer-head > .v2-tabs { min-width: 0; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) transparent; }
.v2-drawer > .v2-icon { grid-area: close; width: 34px; height: auto; align-self: stretch; margin: 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--v-line); border-radius: 0; background: none; }
.v2-drawer:has(> .v2-drawer-head > .v2-tabs[hidden]) > .v2-icon { align-self: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; margin: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--v-line); border-radius: 8px; }
.v2-drawer > .v2-drawer-body { grid-area: body; display: flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0; }
.v2-tab { height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--v-muted); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
.v2-tab.icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; position: relative; padding: 0 10px 0 8px; }
.v2-tab.on { color: var(--v-accent-ink); background: var(--v-accent); border-color: var(--v-accent); }
.v2-drawer [data-more="both"] { mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 64px, #000 calc(100% - 64px), transparent); }
.v2-section-items { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-template-rows: auto; gap: 4px; }
.v2-verb.on { border-color: var(--v-accent); color: var(--v-accent); background: var(--v-accent-soft); }
.v2-orow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 66px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 34px; }
.v2-orow-name { color: var(--v-muted); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.v2-orow-ctrls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.v2-range { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 22px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--v-accent); }
.v2-range-out { min-width: 48px; text-align: right; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--v-text); white-space: nowrap; }

.v2-subhead { margin-top: 4px; padding: 6px 0 2px; border-top: 1px solid var(--v-line); color: var(--v-muted); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.v2-toolopts > .v2-head-tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; padding-top: 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--v-line); }
.v2-choice { min-height: 30px; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--v-line); border-radius: var(--v-r-s); background: var(--v-raise); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; }
.v2-choice.on { color: var(--v-accent-ink); background: var(--v-accent); border-color: var(--v-accent); font-weight: 650; }
.v2-choice.icon { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; min-height: 0; padding: 0; border-color: transparent; background: none; color: var(--v-muted); }
.v2-choice.icon.on { color: var(--v-accent-ink); background: var(--v-accent); border-color: var(--v-accent); }
.v2-stepper { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: 26px minmax(36px, auto) 26px; align-items: center; gap: 2px; }
.v2-stepper-value { padding: 0 2px; text-align: center; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.v2-act { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--v-line); border-radius: var(--v-r-s); background: var(--v-raise); }
.v2-group { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 3px 0; }

.v2-search { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--v-line); border-radius: var(--v-r-s); background: var(--v-bg-solid); color: var(--v-text); user-select: text; }
.v2-swatch { width: 24px; height: 24px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--v-line); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--c); }
.v2-transit-line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 260px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--v-raise); }
.v2-transit-line > i { flex: none; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 3px; }

.v2-side { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: calc(12px + var(--v-hud-h) + 10px); width: 340px; max-height: calc(100dvh - var(--v-hud-h) - var(--v-dock-h) - 60px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; padding: 12px; border-radius: 16px; }

.v2-side .inspector { position: static !important; display: block; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; width: 100% !important; max-height: none !important; padding: 0 !important; border: 0 !important; background: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; transform: none !important; backdrop-filter: none !important; font-size: 13px; }
.v2-side .inspector[data-more-y="both"] { mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, #000 48px, #000 calc(100% - 48px), transparent); }

.v2-tip { position: fixed; z-index: 20; pointer-events: none; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--v-line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--v-bg-solid); color: var(--v-text); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; white-space: pre; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }

.v2-toast { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: calc(12px + var(--v-hud-h) + 10px); transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 10; max-width: min(520px, calc(100vw - 24px)); padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; pointer-events: none; }
@media (max-width: 780px) { .v2-hud { top: 8px; left: 8px; right: 8px; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; padding: 0 8px; } }
@media (max-width: 780px) { .v2-dock { left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: 8px; transform: none; justify-content: space-between; } }
@media (max-width: 780px) { .v2-drawer { left: 8px; right: 8px; width: auto; transform: none; bottom: calc(8px + var(--v-dock-h) + 8px); max-height: 52dvh; } }
.v2-dd-value { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.v2-dd-opt { height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: var(--v-text); font-size: 12.5px; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; }
.v2-pop-title { padding: 6px 10px 4px; color: var(--v-muted); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.v2-note { max-width: 520px; margin: 0; padding: 4px 6px; color: var(--v-muted); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.4; white-space: normal; }
.v2 input[type="range"].v2-range { accent-color: var(--v-accent); color-scheme: dark; cursor: pointer; }
